title: load_messages_for_chat does not capture message state; message_state may be stale
description: load_messages_for_chat returns LoadedMessages but does not return the 'state' field from the Message/get response. The caller in run() sets message_state = 's-4' as a literal in the e2e test (see line 1614 of event.rs tests). In the real run() startup path (lines 875-890), message_state is never set from the Message/get response. It remains empty until the first SSE Message event arrives and Message/changes is called. With empty message_state, the first call uses sinceState='s-0', which is correct as a fallback. But if messages were received between startup and the first SSE event, the changes from that window are missed until the next SSE event triggers a resync. LoadedMessages should carry the state field so the caller can initialize message_state correctly.
